title: August 31 - September 4, 2026
lede: Jobs week, and the chips report into it. Payrolls Friday 7:30am, ISM either side. Four reports land together Tuesday night. Apple changes CEO Tuesday, Tesla launches Cybercab Thursday. Labor Day is Sept 7 — all five sessions open.

heroes.title: WED 9/2 — AVGO, COST & CRWD
heroes.why: AVGO post-close, consensus $3.16 — weakest large semi all month, closed 371.54, carrying the AI-financing question that widened its bond yields in August. COST August sales 3:15pm, July was $23.12B +10.7%. CRWD investor day during the session. Two land fifteen minutes apart.

heroes.title: August Employment Report
heroes.why: Consensus +55k, 4.2% unemployment, 0.2% wages. Core PCE stuck at 3.3% with a third of the bond market pricing a September hike — hot and soft point at different Septembers. ISM Tuesday and Thursday bracket it.

heroes.title: TSLA — Cybercab Launch
heroes.why: Public robotaxi launch, invite-only with livestream. No steering wheel, no pedals; riders may hail one through Tesla's existing app. On the calendar all year without a date until now. Nevada approved the permit 8/21 and the stock ran ~5% on 2x volume.

days.name: MON 8/31
days.note: Month-end. Two conferences open, both belonging to Wednesday's reporters.
econ: Fed monthly G.20 Finance Companies release — volume and composition of loans and leases held by US finance companies
events: SNDK, CRS, ATI join the MSCI World Index. Mechanical buying, fixed date.
Month-end rebalancing. Late volume spike carries no direction.
NKE, MCD, NOC, QCOM this week.

days.name: TUE 9/1
days.note: Four reports one night. Apple changes CEO.
econ: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Aug) — expected to show another month of expansion
events: Ternus replaces Cook, who moves to executive chairman. First change since 2011.
+112% YTD, near a $396 high. Options 73% calls at 5x normal.
Musk, Altman, Huang on one stage, North Carolina.
CRDO double-digit implied; EV deliveries NIO/XPEV/LI/BYDDF; BIDU dual listing effective; UAV Expo opens (AMZN Prime Air, DJI, OUST); KTB Helly Hansen investor day.

days.name: WED 9/2
days.note: The day. AVGO and COST post-close, CRWD during, ADP and JOLTS in the morning.
events: Investor briefing inside Fal.Con. No start time published. Prep's main focus — possible CPW at EOD, wait on the JR signal.
August sales, post-close, confirmed on Costco IR. July $23.12B, +10.7%.

days.name: THU 9/3
days.note: Claims, Waller, ISM Services, then software into payrolls.
econ: Fed Governor Christopher Waller — virtual Reuters NEXT Newsmaker interview
events: Cybercab launch, Austin. Invite-only, livestreamed, no start time announced.
CIEN reads through to AVGO on optical networking; double-digit implied for VSXY and PL; MTCH investor event on Tinder, hosted by CEO Spencer Rascoff.

days.name: FRI 9/4
econ: August Employment Report — consensus +55k payrolls, 4.2% unemployment, 0.2% monthly wage growth
events: Core PCE 3.3%, headline 3.7%. One session to price it.
60 days to the election — managers start repositioning.
Votes on the CRH buyout, trading 3.2% under the $150 deal price.

watch.body: Snapdragon Summit, Sept 22-24, Maui. Next flagship chipset plus the AI and connectivity roadmap. Multi-day, so the move can extend. VERIFIED
Q4 FY2026 earnings. Date from a secondary aggregator, not confirmed against Costco IR. UNVERIFIED
Roadster unveiling, reported to include a flying stunt. No date announced — the announcement is itself the catalyst. UNVERIFIED
Market-wide AI catalyst. The S-1 is the tradeable event — first public financials for a frontier lab, repricing NVDA, AMD, MU, AVGO, CRWV, NBIS. Watch EDGAR. UNVERIFIED

howto: Do not read the first ten minutes Tuesday night.
Four reports land on one close. PANW carries the most positioning of the four.
19% of Intel's revenue is Dell, and INTC has followed DELL's direction 88% of the time after these reports. A stated hit rate on a name that is not the one reporting.
Buy low expectations, not high ones.
MRVL raised both years and fell 8% at +184% YTD. Check what a name has already done before the print, not just what it prints.
Mon-Wed is idiosyncratic, Thu-Fri is macro, and only Friday reprices the curve. An earnings position held into payrolls is a different trade than the one you opened.
foot: Times Central. Earnings pulled 8/30, high-market-cap filter. Payrolls and claims are fixed dates; ADP, JOLTS and ISM Services sit on conventional days — confirm before trading. Tesla and CrowdStrike have published no start times; marked TBA, not estimated. Apple's CEO change is a board-effective date, not a timed event. Labor Day is Sept 7. Catalyst Watch is catalysts.json.
